protocols.title: Endoluten (Pineal Bioregulator) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; these are the page's statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Oral capsule convention: 1–2 capsules daily for 10–30 days, usually 15–20 minutes before a meal; repeat 2–3 courses/year. Animal pineal extract, not Epitalon/Epithalamin; no reconstitution and no validated therapeutic dose.

schedule.description: Usually 15–20 minutes before a meal; repeat 2–3 courses/year.

regimen.notes: Source reports oral capsules and a conventional course, but does not give capsule mass here. Dose is capsule count; no injection or reconstitution.
